title: Query bound for the run
statement: Let an input consist of a positive dimension $n$, positive integers $a,d$ with $2a\le d$, and a Fourier bound $B\ge1$, and let the target be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs. For every natural number $k\le n$, the number of membership queries made by running the program through $k$ stages is at most $k$ times its stage query budget.
hypotheses_covered: Valid deterministic Goldreich–Levin input, including positive dimension, accuracy bounds, and Fourier bound at least one
Target Boolean function on the sign cube
Stage count is at most the input dimension
